title: Parking License Delinquency Threshold and Reinstatement Fee
content:
Collections schedule for the Parking License: the number of days a parking charge may stay past due before parking privileges are suspended, and the product's reinstatement fee for restoring suspended privileges.

| Parking product | Days a parking charge may stay past due before suspension | Reinstatement fee |
|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | 30 | $25.00 |
| Surface Reserved Space | 30 | $25.00 |
| Covered Carport Space | 30 | $25.00 |
| Structured Garage Space | 30 | $25.00 |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 30 | $25.00 |
| Private Detached Garage | 30 | $25.00 |

Both figures are uniform across the six products: 30 days past due, and a reinstatement fee of $25.00.
